name: Doushima Ryuusei
source:
A scary-faced student with a menacing look in his eyes. That being said, his classmates avoid him and he is always by himself. He joined the photography club due to his interest in photography, but blames himself for scaring off all the club members who no longer come. Thus, he forcefully solicits the protagonist to join the club.
